description: Search, browse or look up AboutYou fashion products without cookies or an API key.

brand.description: Keep only products whose brand name contains this text, for example `Levi`.
brand.title: Brand contains

category.description: Top-level shop section used by browse mode. Choose Women, Men or Kids.
category.title: Category

categoryId.description: Optional deeper category, for example `20258` or `https://www.aboutyou.de/c/women/clothing/jeans-20258`. Overrides the top-level category.
categoryId.title: Category ID or category URL

color.description: Keep only products whose color label contains this text, for example `schwarz` or `blue`.
color.title: Color contains

excludeSoldOut.description: Drop products AboutYou has marked as sold out.
excludeSoldOut.title: Exclude sold-out products

maxItems.description: Stop after this many matching products.
maxItems.title: Maximum products

minDiscount.description: Only keep products whose highest variant discount is at least this percentage.
minDiscount.title: Minimum discount (%)

mode.description: Search by keyword, browse a category, or look up exact product URLs.
enumTitles: Look up product URLs or IDs
mode.title: Mode

newOnly.description: Keep only products AboutYou marks as new.
newOnly.title: New arrivals only

priceMax.description: Only keep products whose lowest variant price is at most this amount.
priceMax.title: Maximum price (EUR)

priceMin.description: Only keep products whose lowest variant price is at least this amount.
priceMin.title: Minimum price (EUR)

saleOnly.description: Keep only products that AboutYou has reduced in price.
saleOnly.title: Sale items only

searchQuery.description: Keyword search such as `jeans`, `sneakers` or `summer dress`. Used by search mode.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sort.description: Order results by relevance, price, newest arrival or biggest discount.
sort.title: Sort order

urls.description: AboutYou product links or numeric product IDs, used by byUrl mode.
urls.title: Product URLs or IDs

title: AboutYou Fashion Catalog & Price Scraper Input
